ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all UBOs, directors, and senior managers against the Gibraltar Sanctions Register (Office of Financial Sanctions Implementation), United Nations Security Council Consolidated List, OFAC SDN List, EU Consolidated Sanctions List, UK Sanctions List, and Gibraltar police financial intelligence unit databases. Enhanced due diligence is required for any politically exposed person (PEP), family member, or close associate, including source-of-wealth and source-of-funds verification. Automated ongoing transaction monitoring and adverse media screening must be performed in accordance with Prevention of Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing Regulations 2019 (Gibraltar), international best practice, and FATF Recommendations 12, 17, and 22.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Gibraltar Companies Registry e-Services (https://eservices.companieshouse.gi) operated under the Companies Act 2014
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Company names must be submitted in English using the Latin alphabet (A–Z, 0–9), with no accents, diacritics, or characters outside the standard ASCII set unless specifically approved by the Registrar of Companies. For a Bermuda Exempted Company establishing a registered branch or transferring residence to Gibraltar, the entity must adopt an English name consistent with the original registered name, subject to the suffix rules: 'P.L.C.', 'Ltd ', or 'Limited' are mandatory; the word 'Exempted' may be retained in the Gibraltarian register only if statutory exemption is valid. Foreign-script characters are not permitted as the primary registered name; non-English names require a certified English transliteration and may be recorded as a secondary trading name.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: In the event of a statutory name rejection, the applicant or registered agent must file a formal administrative appeal by submitting Form NAR-1 (Notice of Administrative Review) to the Registrar of Companies, Gibraltar, accompanied by a written explanation demonstrating that the rejected name does not create a misleading association with a prohibited token or same-name conflict. The Registrar shall respond within 21 business days. If the administrative appeal is denied, the applicant may within 30 days file a further appeal to the Companies Appeal Tribunal (Gibraltar) pursuant to Section 612B of the Companies Act 2014. The prescribed fee of GIP 50 applies to the first-level appeal; a second-level tribunal filing carries a GIP 150 fee. Legal representation before the tribunal is not mandatory but is strongly advised.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A virtual office is permissible for the registered office mandate, but a physical street address in Gibraltar must be supplied by a licensed registered agent, and the named individual or body corporate must be present to receive regulatory notices and service of process. For a Market_Research_SaaS consumer polling platform with no physical consumer premises in Gibraltar, a licensed virtual office arrangement is commercially acceptable. However, the registered agent must maintain a physical local presence, and the Gibraltar Income Tax Office expects that a substantive management function—even if performed virtually—will have equivalent local direction if tax residence is claimed. For tax-exempt offshore operation (Bermuda Exempted Company pass-through), virtual office remains permitted subject to full economic substance reporting under the Crown Dependency Economic Substance Amendment Regulations 2020.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Quantified as 8% probability per annum, based on statutory risk-based supervision by the Gibraltar Financial Services Commission and Gibraltar Registrar of Companies. On-site visits are only triggered by suspicious activity, unresolved AML indicators, or routine random audit sampling; for a Low_Risk_Standard consumer polling platform with no regulated financial activity, inspection likelihood is low but non-zero.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Companies Act 2014 (Cap. 100 of the Laws of Gibraltar), ss. 5-20 (formation, memorandum and articles, certificate of incorporation), s. 45 (registered office), ss. 81-115 (directors and company secretary)
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Gibraltar Companies Registry, an operational division of the Gibraltar Financial Services Commission (GFSC), Europort, Gibraltar
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Memorandum and Articles of Association, accompanied by a Statement of Compliance (statutory declaration) and Notice of Registered Office
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital for a Gibraltar private company limited by shares; one subscriber share of GBP 1 or USD 1 is issued at incorporation; no capital escrow account is required by the Companies Registry; additional shares and share premium may be created by board resolution subject to the solvency test.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en:
FIRST MEETING OF THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS OF [COMPANY NAME] LTD (Gibraltar), [DATE].
1. SHARE ALLOTMENT: RESOLVED, that the shares subscribed in the Memorandum and Articles be allotted and issued to the subscriber as recorded in the Register of Members.
2. REGISTERED OFFICE: RESOLVED, that the registered office be established at [ADDRESS, GIBRALTAR] and that the Registrar be notified forthwith.
3. OFFICERS: RESOLVED, that [NAME] be appointed first director and [NAME] company secretary, each having consented to act.
4. BANKING AND INCIDENTALS: RESOLVED, that management be authorized to open payment accounts with Wise and PayPal, execute exempt-company filings, and perform all acts incidental to incorporation.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Gibraltar Companies Registry - Name Search Desk / GFSC e-Portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a name-clearance request via the Companies Registry's online search facility, proposing the principal name '[Company Name] Limited' plus two alternates. The Registry checks proposed names against the statutory register, trade-mark records, and public-policy grounds; written approval is issued within one business day. Retain the name-clearance reference for the formal filing.
required_dossiers: Proposed company name (primary plus two alternatives)
Name availability search request form
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the proposed name is queried for similarity or misleading character, submit the next available alternative or appeal in writing with evidence of distinctiveness and, where applicable, a letter of no-objection from the conflicting name holder.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation and Execution of Constitutional Documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: GFSC-licensed Gibraltar corporate service provider (CSP) with notarization
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Engage a licensed corporate service provider to draft the Memorandum and Articles of Association under the ELF_CUSTOM_BM_EX exempted-company template, specifying authorised share capital, subscriber share provisions, and exempted-status clauses. Each subscriber executes the memorandum in the presence of a witness; the CSP's solicitor signs and submits the Statement of Compliance confirming that all Companies Act 2014 registration requirements are fulfilled. All passports, proof of address, and source-of-wealth statements are notarized and placed in the CSP's AML file.
required_dossiers: Memorandum and Articles of Association (ELF_CUSTOM_BM_EX template)
Statement of Compliance (statutory declaration of conformity)
Notarized passport copies of subscriber, director, and ultimate beneficial owner
Proof of registered office address in Gibraltar
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registry rejects the constitutional documents, including an impermissible share class or an unattested subscriber signature, file a corrective amendment or re-executed Memorandum and Articles of Association within 14 days and pay the resubmission fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Electronic Filing with the Gibraltar Companies Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Gibraltar Companies Registry e-Filing Portal (GFSC Online Portal)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Log on to the Companies Registry e-portal, complete the incorporation e-form with company name, registered office, subscriber and director particulars, and statement of capital, then upload the executed constitution and Statement of Compliance. Pay the state incorporation fee of approximately GBP 100-150 by card and select same-day processing where available. Retain the electronic receipt as proof of submission.
required_dossiers: Electronically signed incorporation e-form
Executed Memorandum and Articles of Association
Statement of Compliance
Registered office consent letter
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the e-filing fails validation, correct the flagged fields, re-upload the complete package, and escalate to the Companies Registry client service desk; same-day express correction is available on payment of the expedited fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Issuance of Certificate of Incorporation and Opening of Statutory Registers
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Gibraltar Companies Registry - Certificate Issuance Unit
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After the Registrar verifies the filing, the Certificate of Incorporation is issued electronically with the company number and date of incorporation. Immediately prepare the statutory registers, including the register of members, register of directors and secretaries, and register of charges, and file the Notice of Registered Office if not already included in the initial application. The certificate is conclusive evidence of compliance with all registration requirements.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Incorporation issued by the Registrar
Notice of Registered Office
Register of Members
Register of Directors and Secretaries
Company seal (optional)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the certificate bears a clerical error in the company number or name, file a rectification request within 21 days; the Registrar will re-issue the certificate without requiring re-incorporation.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Incorporation Governance, Tax Registration, and Payment-Rail Onboarding
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: HM Government of Gibraltar Income Tax Office; Gibraltar Regulatory Authority (GRA); authorized electronic money institution and PayPal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Convene the organizational board meeting and pass the Pro-Forma First Board Resolution covering share allotment, registered office adoption, and officer appointments. Submit officer consents and the Notice of Registered Office to the Registry. Register the company with the Gibraltar Income Tax Office on a territorial corporate-tax basis; no VAT applies in Gibraltar. Submit the GDPR data-controller notification to the GRA for the consumer-panel survey platform. Open a Wise business account and enroll the company for PayPal Mass Payout using the Certificate of Incorporation, board minutes, and UBO declaration as the onboarding dossier.
required_dossiers: Minutes of the First Board Meeting / Pro-forma Board Resolution
Consent to act as director and secretary
Income Tax Office registration application
GRA data-controller notification
Wise and PayPal business account onboarding forms with UBO declaration
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the income-tax registration or GRA notification is queried, submit supplementary UBO and control information through the respective online portals and maintain the exempted-company status statement; any late-filing penalty may be mitigated with a reasoned explanation of administrative error.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: None - no industrial licensing board has jurisdiction over ISIC 7320 digital polling; the Gibraltar Regulatory Authority (GRA) is the relevant authority for data-protection notification only
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Not required - the consumer-panel survey SaaS operates without a physical operating permit; only mandatory GDPR data-controller notification with the GRA and income-tax registration with the Gibraltar Income Tax Office apply

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Department of Environment, Sustainability and Climate Change (DESCC), HM Government of Gibraltar
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt - Category 0 / No EIA screening required; pure digital service with no site development, construction, or industrial installation
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not applicable - zero industrial effluent, zero VOC or stack emissions; office premises remain subject only to municipal solid-waste rules, WEEE disposal standards, and building energy-performance requirements

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Not applicable at industrial scale; the Gibraltar registered office or co-working premises must nevertheless hold a current fire-safety certificate from the Gibraltar Fire and Rescue Service and satisfy the workplace clearance obligations of the Health and Safety at Work Act (Cap. 178), including electrical safety and general risk assessment

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Bermuda (incorporation home): Registrar of Companies; Office of the Tax Commissioner (Ministry of Finance). Gibraltar (operating jurisdiction): HM Government of Gibraltar - Commissioner of Income Tax (Gibraltar Income Tax Office). United Kingdom (indirect-tax nexus pillar): HM Revenue & Customs (HMRC) via gov.uk portal.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Step 1: Incorporate under Bermuda Companies Act 1981; obtain the Registrar's company number (TIN substitute); file for the Exempted Undertaking 40-year tax exemption assurance at incorporation. Step 2: If central management and control is exercised in Gibraltar, register with the Gibraltar Commissioner of Income Tax (Income Tax Act 2010) for a Tax Reference Number (TRN) and file the annual Economic Substance declaration; a foreign branch must instead register under the Companies (Particulars of Branch) Regulations and obtain a branch TRN. Step 3: No Gibraltar VAT ID exists (no local VAT). Step 4: If B2C digital services are supplied to UK consumers, apply immediately with HMRC for UK VAT registration under the Non-UK OSS scheme (or direct VAT registration, Form VAT1) - no turnover threshold; B2B reverse-charge supplies do not trigger UK registration.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Tax_Exempt_Zone: the Bermuda Exempted Company holds a statutory exemption from Bermuda income/capital taxes (tax exemption certificate). Gibraltar territorial taxation (12.5% corporate rate) only attaches to Gibraltar-source income if the company is not managed and controlled in Gibraltar; registration alone does not create Gibraltar residence.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Bermuda: election for Exempted Undertaking status under Companies Act 1981 s.193A/B (40-year binding tax exemption); annual Economic Substance Act filing election. Gibraltar: election as to seat of management/residence under Income Tax Act 2010 and Companies (Economic Substance) Act filing; no check-the-box regime. Hybrid: coordination under UK TIOPA 2010 Part 9A to neutralise any hybrid mismatch if the entity is fiscally transparent or dual-resident in another jurisdiction.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Gibraltar (GI): no VAT/GST/sales tax - import duties/excise only on goods; services are outside the scope of any Gibraltar indirect tax. United Kingdom (GB) pillar: UK VAT (VATA 1994) at 20% standard rate applies on taxable B2C digital supplies to UK consumers; B2B services are reverse-charged. Bermuda: no indirect tax.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Gibraltar (GIP/GBP pegged): nil local threshold - no VAT/GST registration exists. UK pillar: £0 threshold for non-UK established businesses supplying B2C digital services to UK consumers (mandatory registration from first £1 of supplies); £85,000 annual threshold for UK-established businesses; B2B services to UK businesses are outside the supplier's registration obligation (reverse charge).
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No real-time fiscal clearance or digital stamping in Gibraltar (no VAT). UK pillar: Making Tax Digital (MTD) requires digital records and API-based VAT filing via HMRC-recognised software (VAT Notice 700/63); Non-UK OSS quarterly portal filings; customs export declarations via the Customs Declaration Service (CDS); no pre-clearance or HMRC invoice stamping.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Goods: 0% VAT zero-rating under VATA 1994 s.30 and SI 1995/2518 reg.129 where goods are exported from the UK pillar to an outside destination within 3 months, with export evidence retained; goods exported from Gibraltar bear no VAT. Services: the market-research SaaS platform supplies are outside the scope of UK VAT (B2B reverse charge; B2C place-of-supply where the customer belongs) and cannot be 'export zero-rated' - claiming 0% B2C digital supplies would be an unlawful tax advantage.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (UK SAD/CDS via Customs Declaration Service)
Bill of Lading / Air Waybill (sea/air export evidence)
Inward Remittance Certificate (bank evidence of export proceeds; supports the 180-day repatriation verification)
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: HMRC assessments under VATA 1994 s.73 if export evidence is deficient (4-year standard window; 20 years for deliberate inaccuracy); Sch. 24 Finance Act 2007 penalties up to 30% (careless), 70% (deliberate), 100% (deliberate and concealed) of lost UK VAT; clawback of input VAT with statutory interest; s.72 VATA 1994 criminal evasion - unlimited fine and/or up to 7 years' imprisonment; HMRC Civil Investigation of Fraud (CIF) procedures.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Bank of England (monetary authority for the sterling zone) and the Gibraltar Financial Services Commission (GFSC) as the competent banking, e-money, and foreign-exchange regulatory authority for Gibraltar
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Gibraltar pound is pegged at 1:1 to sterling and enjoys full current-account and capital-account convertibility. Gibraltar maintains no exchange-control approvals, no quantitative restrictions, and no profit-remittance licensing. A Bermuda Exempted Company can therefore receive survey-platform revenues and remit dividends, loan repayments, or branch profits through Gibraltar bank accounts in GBP, USD, or EUR, provided source-of-funds and beneficial-ownership documentation, together with any applicable economic-substance filings, are in place. Practical friction arises only where remittances flow to sanctioned, high-risk, or non-cooperative jurisdictions, which triggers enhanced due diligence rather than a currency-conversion permit.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Gibraltar imposes no statutory exchange-control surrender obligation on service-export proceeds. The market-research platform may retain 100% of foreign-currency earnings in a designated bank account, with no mandatory conversion ratio and no central-bank conversion deadline. The only obligations are transaction-reporting thresholds under the Gibraltar AML/CFT framework, sanctions screening, and adequate tax-substance documentation for the Bermuda Exempted Company if it maintains economic activity in Gibraltar.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account – multi-currency settlement, mass-payout, and treasury account
Cross-Border Corporate Account – GBP/EUR/USD current and trade-settlement account
Capital Escrow Account – segregated corporate escrow, savings, and wealth-management account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility Rating: HIGH as a settlement and disbursement rail, but LOW as a primary banking account. Wise Business and PayPal Mass Payout are legally viable for consumer-panel mass payouts after GFSC-compliant onboarding, but neither is a Gibraltar-licensed credit institution and neither can replace the principal operational account. Offshore and UK/EU digital EMIs must pass sanctions screening, cannot offer commercial-loan or FX-hedging infrastructure, and should be used only for micro-payments and batch payouts, with a Gibraltar-licensed bank as the funding and treasury hub.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Gibraltar banks accept remote video-onboarding for a non-resident Bermuda Exempted Company only if the company uses a Gibraltar-licensed corporate-services provider and at least one director or ultimate beneficial owner completes a live video interview. SG Kleinwort Hambros generally requires a physical interview for signatories on accounts with annual turnover above GIP 500,000. Gibraltar International Bank and Jyske Bank permit digital KYC with electronic signatures, notarised corporate extracts, and apostilled Bermuda registry filings. Wholly online opening without a personal interview of at least one director is not available.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Offshore tax-exempt vehicle with no visible employees or premises in Gibraltar or the United Kingdom
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Bermuda Certificate of Exemption, Gibraltar registered-office agreement, economic-substance narrative with payroll and contractor evidence, board minutes, corporate calendar, and a compliance declaration confirming genuine business activity.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Complex ownership chain with nominee directors and the Bermuda Exempted Company limited-liability structure
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Full register of members and directors, 24-month UBO ownership chart, passport and address proof for every 25% or greater beneficial owner, negative bearer-share declaration, certificate of good standing from the Bermuda Registrar, and a Gibraltar-licensed introducer certificate.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Global consumer-panel receipts from thousands of low-ticket PayPal and Wise payments creating an unusual retail aggregation profile
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: AML policy manual, transaction-monitoring rules for micro-payments, PayPal and Wise settlement reconciliation reports, IP-geolocation logs, GDPR/DPA consent records, external audit of payout funding, and documented commercial purpose for consumer polling.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sanctions exposure from cross-border survey participants and remittances to restricted or high-risk territories
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Real-time HM Treasury and OFAC sanctions screening, jurisdiction stop-lists, IP-based geoblocking, contractual AML representations with survey vendors, downstream payment-rail beneficiary screening, and periodic independent compliance review.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Use SWIFT MT103 from the registered shareholder to the beneficiary Gibraltar bank with purpose code 'CAPT' or free-text 'Capital contribution / additional paid-in capital'. The remitter must match the registered shareholder, and the payment narrative must include the legal name of the Bermuda Exempted Company and its Bermuda company number. Required verification includes a board resolution authorising the capital increase, certified register of members, certificate of good standing, and source-of-wealth documentation for injections above GIP 50,000. Payment splitting to avoid reporting thresholds is prohibited.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: For B2B supplier and vendor settlements, use SWIFT MT103 with invoice references; for same-day sterling payments to United Kingdom beneficiaries, use CHAPS or Faster Payments. For consumer-panel micro-incentives, use PayPal Mass Payout and Wise Batch Payment APIs funded from the Gibraltar operational account. Commercial Letters of Credit under UCP 600 are permissible only for documentary trade in physical goods; for pure SaaS and market-research disbursements, direct clearing rails are more cost-efficient. All outbound payments must be sanctions-screened and reconciled against an approved payee list.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: FX forward contracts in GBP/USD and GBP/EUR with a GFSC-licensed credit institution, tenor 0 to 12 months, documented under an ISDA 2002 or local master agreement
Non-deliverable forward (NDF) over GBP/USD or GBP/EUR because the Gibraltar pound is not deliverable outside Gibraltar; NDF notional tied to forecast consumer-panel revenue
Cross-currency swap between GBP and USD or EUR, minimum one-year tenor, matching the shareholder capital injection and projected dividend remittance profile
Spot FX transactions with T+2 settlement for mass-payout wallet balancing and working-capital conversion; speculative options, binary options, and leveraged OTC derivatives are prohibited

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Bermuda Annual Validation and Annual Return (Form AR001) required under the Companies Act 1981 for an Exempted Company
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: January 31 each calendar year; statutory period covered ends August 31 of the preceding calendar year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Incremental late-payment penalties for Exempted Companies (initial BMD 100, rising to BMD 1,000 per month for continued default); after 12 months of unpaid fees the Registrar may publish a strike-off notice in the Official Gazette, and dissolution with asset forfeiture follows where arrears remain unsatisfied.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Beneficial Ownership Register Annual Confirmation under the Beneficial Ownership Act 2016 (Bermuda)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of Companies (Beneficial Ownership Compliance Unit), Bermuda
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Co-filed with Annual Validation on January 31; any share transfer or UBO change during the year must additionally be updated within 14 days of the company becoming aware
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fines of up to BMD 50,000 and terms of imprisonment for defaulting directors or beneficial owners; persistent breach may trigger an official investigation and discretionary administrative strike-off.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Gibraltar Annual Return and prescribed annual fee for a foreign company registered with the Gibraltar Companies House
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Due within 21 days after the anniversary of the Gibraltar registration date; the filing window is aligned with the Bermuda fiscal period to keep group statutory records synchronized
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Civil penalty of £1,000 with interest accruing on unpaid fees; continued default permits the Registrar to strike off the Gibraltar registration and supports director disqualification proceedings.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Gibraltar Economic Substance Return / Prescribed Annual Declaration (ESR regime)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Gibraltar Commissioner of Income Tax (Economic Substance Team)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 12 months after the end of the financial year; submitted electronically through the authorized tax information exchange portal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fixed penalty of £1,000 plus daily default penalties up to a maximum of £10,000; the Commissioner may deem taxable profit on continued default, and the Registrar may initiate strike-off for repeated non-filing.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory independent audit applies under the Bermuda Companies Act 1981 where the Exempted Company holds authorized share capital of BMD 500,000 or more; carries on a licensed undertaking; the Registrar requires audited accounts; or shareholders representing at least 15% of issued capital submit a written audit request. A consumer panel survey platform with no statutory license and capital below the threshold remains outside the compulsory audit requirement, but must be able to present auditable records if its group is an MNE with consolidated revenue exceeding EUR 750 million under the 2024 Bermuda Corporate Income Tax Act.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS as issued by the IASB for cross-border statutory financial reporting; Bermuda GAAP, which converges with IFRS, is acceptable for small Exempted Companies. Revenue from panel subscriptions, survey project fees, and cross-border incentive payouts is recognized under IFRS 15 (Revenue from Contracts with Customers).

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The Bermuda Exempted Company submits an Annual Validation on or before January 31 confirming that the Beneficial Ownership Register is complete and current. Any share transfer or UBO change is reported to the Bermuda Registrar within 14 days and mirrored to the Gibraltar ESR channel within 5 business days. A board-approved transfer policy, a prohibition on bearer shares, and a digital capitalization table permit confirmation without a physical shareholder meeting; the registered agent retains the signed confirmation and maintains the Gibraltar UBO mirror file.

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% (Bermuda exempted-company rate); Gibraltar standard rate of 12.5% applies only if the company is managed and controlled from Gibraltar or has a Gibraltar permanent establishment.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Bermuda: no corporate income tax, no capital gains tax, and no withholding tax for exempted undertakings holding a Tax Protection Certificate; statutory exemption guaranteed to 2035 and subject to extension. Gibraltar: no specific incentive for market research/SaaS; territorial taxation may exclude non-Gibraltar-source income not derived in or received into Gibraltar; no patent box applies.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Bermuda Annual Return and Economic Substance Return; filed with the Bermuda Registrar of Companies and the Bermuda ESR Online Portal.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Companies Act annual return due within 45 days of the anniversary of incorporation; ESR return due within 6 months after financial year-end.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered company name, Bermuda company number, registered office in Bermuda, statutory directors and resident representative.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: State 'Bermuda exempted company'; confirm registered office location; list non-resident beneficial owner if required under the register.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Relevant activity declaration under Bermuda Economic Substance Regulations.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Select 'None' unless the company performs IP, headquarters, distribution, service-centre or other listed activity; consumer panel survey platform activity for its own account is not a listed activity.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross income from relevant activity, employee headcount, business premises, operating expenditure and core income-generating activities.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Complete proportionally using Bermuda substantive figures; retain board minutes, employment contracts and lease agreements in Bermuda.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Bermuda: BD$10,000 initial penalty and BD$10,000 per day for ESR non-filing; Companies Act return failures attract late fees and default dissolution; continuing default triggers mandatory strike-off.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Gibraltar Corporation Tax Return (Form CIT); filed through HM Government of Gibraltar Income Tax Office electronic filing portal.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within 12 months after the end of the chargeable accounting period; tax is computed on the company's accounting period.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gibraltar Tax Identification Number, company name, registered office, accounting period start and end dates.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For a Bermuda incorporated company managed and controlled from Gibraltar, provide certificate of incorporation and Bermuda tax reference; otherwise declare no Gibraltar fiscal presence.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Principal business activity code: ISIC 7320 / NAICS 541910, consumer polling and cross-border market research platform.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Describe the SaaS survey platform and payment flows; do not characterise the activity as pure e-commerce in a way that conceals a Gibraltar permanent establishment.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross receipts from subscriptions, panel survey fees and platform commissions.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report all revenues attributable to a Gibraltar permanent establishment; revenues settled through PayPal or Wise must match transfer pricing documentation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Allowable deductions: subcontractor survey costs, data hosting, payment processing fees and operating expenses.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Disallow intercompany charges lacking OECD-compliant transfer pricing evidence; retain time and activity logs if a Gibraltar permanent establishment exists.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Adjusted taxable profit or loss and losses carried forward.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident filers show nil unless a taxable permanent establishment exists; attach board minutes demonstrating management and control outside Gibraltar.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax liability at 12.5% less prepayments and credits; final amount due or refund.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Claim foreign tax credit relief only for treaty-covered income; do not claim credit for Bermuda non-tax.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Gibraltar: late filing penalty of GBP 100 plus daily surcharges up to GBP 50 per day for a maximum of 100 days; inaccurate returns attract additional penalties up to 100% of the tax; failure to pay may trigger enforcement action and a public register of tax defaulters.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% in Bermuda and Gibraltar for dividends paid by the exempted company; no Gibraltar withholding tax on distributions to non-resident shareholders.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: No source-country withholding is imposed on dividends paid by the Bermuda exempted company, so no DTA protocol is needed for outbound dividends. For inbound payments, treaty relief requires: (i) a Bermuda Tax Residence Certificate or Tax Protection Certificate issued by the Bermuda Registrar of Companies or Ministry of Finance; (ii) a completed source-country relief declaration before payment; (iii) supporting substance evidence including board minutes, office lease, payroll and bank account details; and (iv) confirmation that the Bermuda company is beneficial owner of the income. Gibraltar substance evidence is relevant only if the Bermuda company is also managed and controlled in Gibraltar.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Bermuda domestic statutory withholding tax on cross-border royalties and interest: 0%. Gibraltar domestic withholding tax on outbound royalties and interest: 0%. UK source royalty withholding is 20% at the domestic statutory rate, reducible to 0% under the UK-Bermuda and UK-Gibraltar double taxation arrangements for beneficial owners without a UK permanent establishment. Intercompany interest on commercial loans is generally paid without UK withholding.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: GBP 1,000,000 aggregated connected-party transactions in an accounting period for Gibraltar Local File; Master File required for a multinational group with consolidated turnover above GBP 50,000,000. Bermuda ESR transfer pricing directions require contemporaneous documentation for material cross-border related-party transactions above USD 1,000,000.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Bermuda and Gibraltar both apply OECD-aligned Economic Substance Regulations. The consumer panel survey platform is not a listed relevant activity unless it earns royalty income from IP, operates as a related-party service centre, headquarters, distribution centre, or financing entity. If any listed activity exists, the entity must demonstrate board meetings, qualified employees, business premises and core income-generating activities in Bermuda, or in Gibraltar if tax-resident there. Annual ESR filings must be consistent with transfer pricing records. For a Bermuda exempted company claiming no Gibraltar tax presence, substance must be real and not satisfied by the use of PayPal Mass Payout or Wise payment rails.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Filing a Gibraltar nil return while employees, office space and board decision-making remain in Gibraltar; invoicing all platform revenue through the Bermuda company with no substance; deliberately omitting profits attributable to a Gibraltar permanent establishment.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Additional assessment up to 100% of tax evaded, civil penalties up to GBP 3,000 per return, criminal fines unlimited on indictment, and confiscation orders under Proceeds of Crime legislation.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors are jointly and severally liable for unlawful distributions and unpaid tax in civil recovery; courts may impose travel bans, asset freezes, disqualification for up to 15 years, and imprisonment for up to 7 years for fraudulent evasion.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell company and sham economic substance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Maintaining the Bermuda exempted company as a letterbox with no office, no local payroll and no board meetings; using PayPal/Wise mass payouts to avoid regulatory oversight; failing to file the Bermuda ESR return while transacting above the materiality threshold.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Bermuda: BD$10,000 initial penalty plus BD$10,000 per day of continuing default and cancellation of exempted status. Gibraltar: striking-off from the register and de facto permanent establishment assessment including interest and penalties.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Reckless directors may be personally liable for corporate liabilities under wrongful trading principles; disqualification from managing any Bermuda or Gibraltar company; reciprocal UK enforcement may include travel watchlisting and removal from registered officer positions.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using PayPal Mass Payout and Wise to pay survey respondents without verifying beneficial ownership or sanctions screening; allowing mass payout campaigns to operate through the platform for third parties while the Bermuda company is presented as a tax-free payment funnel.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Gibraltar AML fines up to GBP 250,000 and serious crime confiscation; Bermuda fines under its anti-money laundering framework; suspension of payment-processor accounts; regulatory disqualification of officers.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors serving as money laundering reporting officers face personal criminal liability, asset restraint, travel bans and imprisonment up to 14 years under Gibraltar's Proceeds of Crime and AML legislation; civil recovery may pierce the corporate veil where the company is found to be a sham.
